text: Well, were you up too late watching Beavis and Butthead or organizing your stamp collection?
Actually, I was up early this morning. My rat stole my wallet.
Yeah, you just couldn't haul your lazy butt out of bed, huh?
I, on the other hand, have a social life.
Yes, I was out dancing until dawn.
But here I am on time and fresh as a daisy.
A daisy, huh? You know, I could say something.
Don't you go there! Don't go there!
I'll have to see you later, mean boy.
